page_title: LED display screen (taxi roof light) configuration and use
page_content:
[TOC]

### Installation list
| Name | Quantity | Name | Quantity |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ | ------------ |
| MDVR device | 1 | MDVR 232 IO harness | 1 |
| Remote controller | 1 | Display | 1 |
| LED display (taxi roof light) | 1 | Common wiring tools | n |

### Necessary instructions
- Here we take **MX-LED-taxi-jrcx-232** as an example
- LED display screen DC head + independent adapter power supply

** Actual picture **:
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5e884e7e17f2695dd4721fdbeb778947)
MX-LED-taxi-jrcx-232

### Operation steps
#### 1. Wiring
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=7ed2258b9492b391f3dfbdf8e48e396f)

#### 2. Device menu configuration
2.1 Remote control enters menu>>Settings>>Serial>>Serial, serial port index configuration RS232, serial port function LDE display, baud rate configuration 2500, other parameters default, confirm and save.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=4020f670e94f5a145d31f733886bec00)

2.2 Press the return key on the remote control to enter Settings>>Network Settings>>Center Menu interface, move to the bottom column to fill in the transparent transmission address and port provided by the manufacturer, confirm and save and restart to take effect.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=8d60cf3a94b7e5600abf9ba16915a10a)

#### 3. Test
3.1 Log in to the LED wireless advertising client, click Edit Program>>Write the title number (such as Promotion)>>Enter the advertising slogan (such as Congratulations and Get Rich), and save it.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d55481656c6b79aefc472f953b0127eb)

3.2 Click Publish Program again>>Check the role in the default group>>Check the title number under the index, and publish the program.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d6febf91ba8c843ebebc42093249055b)
